lines.speaker: TEAL
lines.text: Two taps. That's me. If you're hearing this, I missed a check-in, and you're sitting in my chair because nobody else wanted the paperwork.
lines.spoken: Two taps. That's me. If you're hearing this, I missed a check-in, and you're sitting in my chair because nobody else wanted the paperwork.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: He missed three. He told me once: one check-in is weather, two is trouble, three is worry. I've been worried since Tuesday.
lines.spoken: He missed three. He told me once: one check-in is weather, two is trouble, three is worry. I've been worried since Tuesday.

lines.speaker: TEAL
lines.text: Sparrow. You fly the pattern too low and too fast, and I never fixed it, because it's the only thing you do without asking permission.
lines.spoken: Sparrow. You fly the pattern too low and too fast, and I never fixed it, because it's the only thing you do without asking permission.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: Command calls it desertion. They made me say the word on the net. I said it. I'm not saying it again.
lines.spoken: Command calls it desertion. They made me say the word on the net. I said it. I'm not saying it again.

lines.speaker: TEAL
lines.text: If I miss your checkout, fly the pattern anyway. The sky will still be there.
lines.spoken: If I miss your checkout, fly the pattern anyway. The sky will still be there.

lines.speaker: TRAINEE
lines.text: An empty chair and a checkout nobody's signing. Fine. I'll fly the pattern.
lines.spoken: An empty chair and a checkout nobody's signing. Fine. I'll fly the pattern.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: The bombers wore our markings. Our paint, our numbers. One of them was a tail I cleared for departure in March.
lines.spoken: The bombers wore our markings. Our paint, our numbers. One of them was a tail I cleared for departure in March.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: The quartermaster found a case under Teal's bunk. A coffee tin, twelve tapes, and a note: 'For Sera. Not for the net.'
lines.spoken: The quartermaster found a case under Teal's bunk. A coffee tin, twelve tapes, and a note: 'For Sera. Not for the net.'

lines.speaker: TEAL
lines.text: Keep these off the command net. Somebody up there is listening and signing things they shouldn't. If I go quiet, the case goes to Sera. Only Sera.
lines.spoken: Keep these off the command net. Somebody up there is listening and signing things they shouldn't. If I go quiet, the case goes to Sera. Only Sera.

lines.speaker: TEAL
lines.text: The manifest calls it grain. It's aviation fuel: drums to a farm with a runway, then on to the Iron Coast docks. Nobody ships grain in drums.
lines.spoken: The manifest calls it grain. It's aviation fuel: drums to a farm with a runway, then on to the Iron Coast docks. Nobody ships grain in drums.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: There are real houses in that yard. Families who work the siding. I need you to come home with the right number of fires.
lines.spoken: There are real houses in that yard. Families who work the siding. I need you to come home with the right number of fires.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: Iron Coast is a hundred miles of our own shoreline. Whoever this is, they're not invading. They're already home.
lines.spoken: Iron Coast is a hundred miles of our own shoreline. Whoever this is, they're not invading. They're already home.

lines.speaker: TRAINEE
lines.text: Then I'll look at that farm. From above, before anyone can tidy it up.
lines.spoken: Then I'll look at that farm. From above, before anyone can tidy it up.

lines.speaker: TEAL
lines.text: I dropped beacons on the way in. Low power, my own frequency. If anyone ever follows me, I wanted it to be someone who knew the song.
lines.spoken: I dropped beacons on the way in. Low power, my own frequency. If anyone ever follows me, I wanted it to be someone who knew the song.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: He used to tune that pass on Sundays. Said it was the only place the tower couldn't talk to him.
lines.spoken: He used to tune that pass on Sundays. Said it was the only place the tower couldn't talk to him.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: Recovery followed the beacons into the snowy pass. His receiver was in the rocks. Cracked case, memory intact. He meant us to find it.
lines.spoken: Recovery followed the beacons into the snowy pass. His receiver was in the rocks. Cracked case, memory intact. He meant us to find it.

lines.speaker: TEAL
lines.text: There's a radar inside our own training box. Dug into the bowl north of the pass. Nobody signed for it. I checked the ledger three times.
lines.spoken: There's a radar inside our own training box. Dug into the bowl north of the pass. Nobody signed for it. I checked the ledger three times.

lines.speaker: TEAL
lines.text: Somebody wanted to watch trainees. Not the sky. Trainees. Think about why you'd want to know when the kids fly.
lines.spoken: Somebody wanted to watch trainees. Not the sky. Trainees. Think about why you'd want to know when the kids fly.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: If it's real, it's been watching every pattern you've flown for a year. Command wants it gone quietly. I want it photographed first.
lines.spoken: If it's real, it's been watching every pattern you've flown for a year. Command wants it gone quietly. I want it photographed first.

lines.speaker: TRAINEE
lines.text: If I just blow it up, it's a rumour. If I look at it first, it's a crime.
lines.spoken: If I just blow it up, it's a rumour. If I look at it first, it's a crime.

lines.speaker: TEAL
lines.text: The Teklan farmers let me hide a tape in a seed tin. The old woman asked my name, not my rank. Nobody at Varda has asked my name in ten years.
lines.spoken: The Teklan farmers let me hide a tape in a seed tin. The old woman asked my name, not my rank. Nobody at Varda has asked my name in ten years.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: The radar's memory names that orchard. Three days later somebody ordered it evacuated. Now there are patrols firing on the evacuation trucks.
lines.spoken: The radar's memory names that orchard. Three days later somebody ordered it evacuated. Now there are patrols firing on the evacuation trucks.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: They're not shooting at farmers. They're shooting at a seed tin. That's how badly someone wants Teal's tape back.
lines.spoken: They're not shooting at farmers. They're shooting at a seed tin. That's how badly someone wants Teal's tape back.

lines.speaker: RUSK
lines.text: ...three officers at Varda are being reassigned tonight. Their names are already off the roster. Nobody will ask. Nobody ever asks.
lines.spoken: ...three officers at Varda are being reassigned tonight. Their names are already off the roster. Nobody will ask. Nobody ever asks.

lines.speaker: TEAL
lines.text: The couriers fly the patrol routes high over the orchard hills. They're the patrols' eyes. Close them, and the road goes quiet.
lines.spoken: The couriers fly the patrol routes high over the orchard hills. They're the patrols' eyes. Close them, and the road goes quiet.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: Three transports above the hills, with escorts hidden by two jammers. Find the transports and the families have a road out.
lines.spoken: Three transports above the hills, with escorts hidden by two jammers. Find the transports and the families have a road out.

lines.speaker: TRAINEE
lines.text: Those trucks are carrying somebody who asked his name. They get out.
lines.spoken: Those trucks are carrying somebody who asked his name. They get out.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: The convoy made it. The old woman's granddaughter drove the lead truck. She marked three silos on the map with her thumb. 'Those smell wrong.'
lines.spoken: The convoy made it. The old woman's granddaughter drove the lead truck. She marked three silos on the map with her thumb. 'Those smell wrong.'

lines.speaker: TEAL
lines.text: Three tanks under grain permits. Aviation fuel. The farmers know the difference, they just can't prove it. A fuel ledger would prove it.
lines.spoken: Three tanks under grain permits. Aviation fuel. The farmers know the difference, they just can't prove it. A fuel ledger would prove it.

lines.speaker: TEAL
lines.text: Sparrow. Every unmarked silo in that valley is somebody's winter. Don't be the one who makes them hungry to make a point.
lines.spoken: Sparrow. Every unmarked silo in that valley is somebody's winter. Don't be the one who makes them hungry to make a point.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: He wrote that one for you. He never wrote anything for me. I'm choosing not to be hurt by that today.
lines.spoken: He wrote that one for you. He never wrote anything for me. I'm choosing not to be hurt by that today.

lines.speaker: TEAL
lines.text: Vulture Lead followed me into the pass. He wasn't chasing a deserter. You don't chase deserters at night with your lights off. He was erasing a witness.
lines.spoken: Vulture Lead followed me into the pass. He wasn't chasing a deserter. You don't chase deserters at night with your lights off. He was erasing a witness.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: If the fuel burns, he'll come looking for you over the works. You don't owe him a duel. Bring yourself home.
lines.spoken: If the fuel burns, he'll come looking for you over the works. You don't owe him a duel. Bring yourself home.

lines.speaker: TRAINEE
lines.text: Three thumbprints. Three fires. Then I'm leaving him in the dark.
lines.spoken: Three thumbprints. Three fires. Then I'm leaving him in the dark.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: You got clear of Vulture Lead. His orders kept repeating on guard; we recorded them. Every one is signed by a man who died in spring.
lines.spoken: You got clear of Vulture Lead. His orders kept repeating on guard; we recorded them. Every one is signed by a man who died in spring.

lines.speaker: TEAL
lines.text: Kiro talks to Lira. Lira talks to Merel. Merel talks to the harbours. Start at the docks; listen back up the chain.
lines.spoken: Kiro talks to Lira. Lira talks to Merel. Merel talks to the harbours. Start at the docks; listen back up the chain.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: I wiped his name off my board this morning. Then I wrote it back. I'm not ready to decide what he is.
lines.spoken: I wiped his name off my board this morning. Then I wrote it back. I'm not ready to decide what he is.

lines.speaker: TEAL
lines.text: On the coast, look at what the cranes unload. The uniforms tell you nothing. The crates do.
lines.spoken: On the coast, look at what the cranes unload. The uniforms tell you nothing. The crates do.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: Iron Coast. His supply depots sit beside a fish market. The Marshal put them where he knew we'd hesitate.
lines.spoken: Iron Coast. His supply depots sit beside a fish market. The Marshal put them where he knew we'd hesitate.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: Workers live two blocks from those docks. The cargo ships and fuel barges are his supply line. Their neighbours are not.
lines.spoken: Workers live two blocks from those docks. The cargo ships and fuel barges are his supply line. Their neighbours are not.

lines.speaker: TRAINEE
lines.text: He's right. I'll hesitate. Then I'll aim.
lines.spoken: He's right. I'll hesitate. Then I'll aim.

lines.speaker: TEAL
lines.text: Kiro keeps an archive. Every forged order, filed, because forgers are vain. It's the only honest thing on the plateau.
lines.spoken: Kiro keeps an archive. Every forged order, filed, because forgers are vain. It's the only honest thing on the plateau.

lines.speaker: RUSK
lines.text: Declare the emergency first. Find the reason after. In a year, nobody has asked me for the reason.
lines.spoken: Declare the emergency first. Find the reason after. In a year, nobody has asked me for the reason.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: The harbour traffic gave us Kiro's signing key. A key alone is a rumour. We need Lira and Merel's logs with the same signature.
lines.spoken: The harbour traffic gave us Kiro's signing key. A key alone is a rumour. We need Lira and Merel's logs with the same signature.

lines.speaker: TEAL
lines.text: Lira and Merel sit on opposite ridges and hate each other's weather. Lira lies, Merel repeats her. The west ridge still hears the farms.
lines.spoken: Lira and Merel sit on opposite ridges and hate each other's weather. Lira lies, Merel repeats her. The west ridge still hears the farms.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: Three logs, one signature. Send them home to Varda. Its island transmitter can reach the farms without borrowing his voice.
lines.spoken: Three logs, one signature. Send them home to Varda. Its island transmitter can reach the farms without borrowing his voice.

lines.speaker: TEAL
lines.text: I came home through the pass. Not the pretty way. The way you take when you don't want to be seen coming home.
lines.spoken: I came home through the pass. Not the pretty way. The way you take when you don't want to be seen coming home.

lines.speaker: TRAINEE
lines.text: His own words, in his own voice, on their own relay. He'd have liked that.
lines.spoken: His own words, in his own voice, on their own relay. He'd have liked that.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: Three stations, one signature. Varda's island transmitter has the orders and proof their signer died in spring. Thirty-five seconds.
lines.spoken: Three stations, one signature. Varda's island transmitter has the orders and proof their signer died in spring. Thirty-five seconds.

lines.speaker: TEAL
lines.text: A clear signal needs time. Don't give them a hero. Give them thirty-five seconds and a hero is beside the point.
lines.spoken: A clear signal needs time. Don't give them a hero. Give them thirty-five seconds and a hero is beside the point.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: He recorded that two weeks before he vanished. Thirty-five seconds. He'd already timed it. He knew exactly what this would take.
lines.spoken: He recorded that two weeks before he vanished. Thirty-five seconds. He'd already timed it. He knew exactly what this would take.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: I'm staying in the tower. In case you were wondering. I'm not leaving my chair for them.
lines.spoken: I'm staying in the tower. In case you were wondering. I'm not leaving my chair for them.

lines.speaker: TRAINEE
lines.text: Keep the lights on, Sera. I'll keep the sky.
lines.spoken: Keep the lights on, Sera. I'll keep the sky.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: Three garrisons heard it. Two stood down. Their people are coming ashore to join us.
lines.spoken: Three garrisons heard it. Two stood down. Their people are coming ashore to join us.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: Three loyalist frigates cover the landing under the weather. The command ship carries a green beacon and most of our hope.
lines.spoken: Three loyalist frigates cover the landing under the weather. The command ship carries a green beacon and most of our hope.

lines.speaker: TEAL
lines.text: Storms ground frightened people. They don't ground orders, or fuel, or the people who own them. When the weather's bad, that's when they move.
lines.spoken: Storms ground frightened people. They don't ground orders, or fuel, or the people who own them. When the weather's bad, that's when they move.

lines.speaker: TEAL
lines.text: If I don't get home, leave the lane open for the next one. That's the job. There isn't a second part.
lines.spoken: If I don't get home, leave the lane open for the next one. That's the job. There isn't a second part.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: The frigate captain was at his wing ceremony. Half this coast was. The Marshal forgot that we all remember.
lines.spoken: The frigate captain was at his wing ceremony. Half this coast was. The Marshal forgot that we all remember.

lines.speaker: TRAINEE
lines.text: Green beacon. I'll stay close enough to read it.
lines.spoken: Green beacon. I'll stay close enough to read it.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: And then the Marshal answered. He turned on the orchard, and put a line of guns along the rivers.
lines.spoken: And then the Marshal answered. He turned on the orchard, and put a line of guns along the rivers.

lines.speaker: RUSK
lines.text: Varda Rim has broadcast enemy propaganda. It is a hostile station. The Teklan orchard sheltered the source. There will be no further warnings.
lines.spoken: Varda Rim has broadcast enemy propaganda. It is a hostile station. The Teklan orchard sheltered the source. There will be no further warnings.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: The orchard burned at noon. The old woman is alive. Her granddaughter is alive. The seed tin is ash. That's my report, and I hate it.
lines.spoken: The orchard burned at noon. The old woman is alive. Her granddaughter is alive. The seed tin is ash. That's my report, and I hate it.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: I asked you to broadcast. I'd ask again. I need you to know that I'd ask again.
lines.spoken: I asked you to broadcast. I'd ask again. I need you to know that I'd ask again.

lines.speaker: TRAINEE
lines.text: The rain has passed. The line hasn't. I'll take the valleys.
lines.spoken: The rain has passed. The line hasn't. I'll take the valleys.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: The old woman heard Teal in her kitchen before the fire. She says he sounded tired. Now her neighbours are flying out over his saddle.
lines.spoken: The old woman heard Teal in her kitchen before the fire. She says he sounded tired. Now her neighbours are flying out over his saddle.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: Teal flew that saddle on his checkride. Vulture Two signed the card. I pulled it last night. The handwriting matches the forged orders.
lines.spoken: Teal flew that saddle on his checkride. Vulture Two signed the card. I pulled it last night. The handwriting matches the forged orders.

lines.speaker: TEAL
lines.text: Two civilian airliners. One cannot climb. Somebody will have to leave the high sky to keep the lower one safe.
lines.spoken: Two civilian airliners. One cannot climb. Somebody will have to leave the high sky to keep the lower one safe.

lines.speaker: TRAINEE
lines.text: Then I'll fly his checkride for him. Properly, this time.
lines.spoken: Then I'll fly his checkride for him. Properly, this time.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: The eight towers in that crater are the Marshal's command array. The antennas up there are his. So is the pilot waiting above them.
lines.spoken: The eight towers in that crater are the Marshal's command array. The antennas up there are his. So is the pilot waiting above them.

lines.speaker: VULTURE TWO
lines.text: Varda trainee, this is Vulture Two. I taught your instructor to fly. I know what he'd try over that crater. Turn home. Nobody has to watch.
lines.spoken: Varda trainee, this is Vulture Two. I taught your instructor to fly. I know what he'd try over that crater. Turn home. Nobody has to watch.

lines.speaker: TEAL
lines.text: Vulture Two taught me that an order is not the same as a duty. Then he forgot. If you meet him, remind him. Loudly.
lines.spoken: Vulture Two taught me that an order is not the same as a duty. Then he forgot. If you meet him, remind him. Loudly.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: He's challenged your call sign in daylight. He wants you above the crater, where he can see your face.
lines.spoken: He's challenged your call sign in daylight. He wants you above the crater, where he can see your face.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: If he ejects, mark where he lands. We need a witness who can answer back.
lines.spoken: If he ejects, mark where he lands. We need a witness who can answer back.

lines.speaker: TRAINEE
lines.text: Then he'll see it.
lines.spoken: Then he'll see it.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: Vulture Two ejected. Marines lifted him out of the crater. He asked if you were Teal's. I said yes.
lines.spoken: Vulture Two ejected. Marines lifted him out of the crater. He asked if you were Teal's. I said yes.

lines.speaker: VULTURE TWO
lines.text: He was the best I ever signed off. Tell the kid the handwriting was mine. All of it. I'm done lying to pilots.
lines.spoken: He was the best I ever signed off. Tell the kid the handwriting was mine. All of it. I'm done lying to pilots.

lines.speaker: TEAL
lines.text: I made a paper copy. Radios get jammed. Ink still travels. It's in the harbour master's safe, and she doesn't like the Marshal either.
lines.spoken: I made a paper copy. Radios get jammed. Ink still travels. It's in the harbour master's safe, and she doesn't like the Marshal either.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: The harbour master's copy and Vulture Two's statement are on one slow plane. Airships are jamming the ravine. Fighters are waiting beyond it.
lines.spoken: The harbour master's copy and Vulture Two's statement are on one slow plane. Airships are jamming the ravine. Fighters are waiting beyond it.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: The signatures, his tapes, a living witness on paper. If that plane falls, command gets to call him a deserter again.
lines.spoken: The signatures, his tapes, a living witness on paper. If that plane falls, command gets to call him a deserter again.

lines.speaker: TRAINEE
lines.text: Then it doesn't fall.
lines.spoken: Then it doesn't fall.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: The evidence plane is clear. Its papers point to the crown station on the ice coast. Missiles are closing on the dish; we need its archive intact.
lines.spoken: The evidence plane is clear. Its papers point to the crown station on the ice coast. Missiles are closing on the dish; we need its archive intact.

lines.speaker: TEAL
lines.text: At the crown station I left the order that started all of this. The first one. With his real signature, before he learned to use dead men's names.
lines.spoken: At the crown station I left the order that started all of this. The first one. With his real signature, before he learned to use dead men's names.

lines.speaker: TEAL
lines.text: I didn't take it with me. I didn't trust myself to get home. I trusted the dish.
lines.spoken: I didn't take it with me. I didn't trust myself to get home. I trusted the dish.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: He didn't trust himself to get home. He said it out loud, to a tape, and flew anyway. I keep rewinding that part.
lines.spoken: He didn't trust himself to get home. He said it out loud, to a tape, and flew anyway. I keep rewinding that part.

lines.speaker: TRAINEE
lines.text: He trusted the dish. I can do that much.
lines.spoken: He trusted the dish. I can do that much.

lines.speaker: LOG
lines.text: ARCHIVE RECOVERED. ORDER 0001. 'Declare regional emergency. Suspend parliament. Assume air command.' Signed: RUSK, AIR MARSHAL.
lines.spoken: Archive recovered. Order zero-zero-zero-one. Declare regional emergency. Suspend parliament. Assume air command. Signed: Rusk, Air Marshal.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: Rusk. He gave the speech at Teal's wing ceremony. He told us the sky belongs to whoever is willing to be up in it.
lines.spoken: Rusk. He gave the speech at Teal's wing ceremony. He told us the sky belongs to whoever is willing to be up in it.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: Marines have the paper copy. Now the archive gives us his signature too. And the city still hears nothing but him.
lines.spoken: Marines have the paper copy. Now the archive gives us his signature too. And the city still hears nothing but him.

lines.speaker: RUSK
lines.text: Citizens. Parliament has fled. Rebel aircraft are over the harbour. Stay inside. Trust the lights. Trust my voice.
lines.spoken: Citizens. Parliament has fled. Rebel aircraft are over the harbour. Stay inside. Trust the lights. Trust my voice.

lines.speaker: TEAL
lines.text: One tower, one voice, one emergency on repeat. He didn't build it to tell anyone anything. He built it so nothing else gets in.
lines.spoken: One tower, one voice, one emergency on repeat. He didn't build it to tell anyone anything. He built it so nothing else gets in.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: The broadcast relay sits in a block of apartments. He chose that too. The canal is the only dark line through the city.
lines.spoken: The broadcast relay sits in a block of apartments. He chose that too. The canal is the only dark line through the city.

lines.speaker: TRAINEE
lines.text: Everyone in those apartments has been listening to him for a year. I'd like to give them some quiet.
lines.spoken: Everyone in those apartments has been listening to him for a year. I'd like to give them some quiet.

lines.speaker: RUSK
lines.text: Trainee. This is Rusk. Teal flew my wing the winter the coast starved while parliament debated. He had talent too. Ask the pass how far it got him.
lines.spoken: Trainee. This is Rusk. Teal flew my wing the winter the coast starved while parliament debated. He had talent too. Ask the pass how far it got him.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: That's the first time he's used his own name. He wants you to know he's a person. Don't let him.
lines.spoken: That's the first time he's used his own name. He wants you to know he's a person. Don't let him.

lines.speaker: TRAINEE
lines.text: He flew your wing. Vulture Lead hunted him for you. I'll remember who gave the order.
lines.spoken: He flew your wing. Vulture Lead hunted him for you. I'll remember who gave the order.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: A loyalist column is crossing the dry coast. Parliament is coming home by road. The ruined town ahead of them still has guns.
lines.spoken: A loyalist column is crossing the dry coast. Parliament is coming home by road. The ruined town ahead of them still has guns.

lines.speaker: TEAL
lines.text: Don't fly for the people giving orders. Fly for the people who have to live beneath them. The man on the net is weather.
lines.spoken: Don't fly for the people giving orders. Fly for the people who have to live beneath them. The man on the net is weather.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: He recorded that one at two in the morning. I can hear the hangar heater behind him. I could find that hangar in the dark by that sound.
lines.spoken: He recorded that one at two in the morning. I can hear the hangar heater behind him. I could find that hangar in the dark by that sound.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: Clear the bunkers ahead of the column. Stay on their channel until both squads answer from the streets.
lines.spoken: Clear the bunkers ahead of the column. Stay on their channel until both squads answer from the streets.

lines.speaker: TRAINEE
lines.text: Beneath them. Right. The road, then.
lines.spoken: Beneath them. Right. The road, then.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: Recovery reached the upper pass this morning. They found his aircraft. They found him. He was in the seat. The recorder was still running.
lines.spoken: Recovery reached the upper pass this morning. They found his aircraft. They found him. He was in the seat. The recorder was still running.

lines.speaker: RECORDER
lines.text: RECORDER 7-T. ENTRY 04:12. PLAYBACK.
lines.spoken: Recorder seven-T. Entry oh-four-twelve. Playback.

lines.speaker: TEAL
lines.text: Two taps. Sparrow, it's me. Lead is on my tail and I'm out of altitude, so I'm going to stay in the pass a while. The seed trucks need ten minutes.
lines.spoken: Two taps. Sparrow, it's me. Lead is on my tail and I'm out of altitude, so I'm going to stay in the pass a while. The seed trucks need ten minutes.

lines.speaker: TEAL
lines.text: I flew that order knowing the price. The tapes are so you never have to take my word for any of it. This part I'm choosing myself.
lines.spoken: I flew that order knowing the price. The tapes are so you never have to take my word for any of it. This part I'm choosing myself.

lines.speaker: TEAL
lines.text: Fly the pattern too low and too fast. Nobody ever fixed it. Good. The sky will...
lines.spoken: Fly the pattern too low and too fast. Nobody ever fixed it. Good. The sky will...

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: Witnesses reach parliament tonight. Keep the bridges and the docks open. Rusk leads four wingmen over the capital. Vulture Lead is one of them.
lines.spoken: Witnesses reach parliament tonight. Keep the bridges and the docks open. Rusk leads four wingmen over the capital. Vulture Lead is one of them.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: I've amended the record myself. 'Aircraft lost with pilot. KILLED, NOT DESERTED.' Command can court-martial the paperwork.
lines.spoken: I've amended the record myself. Aircraft lost with pilot. Killed, not deserted. Command can court-martial the paperwork.

lines.speaker: TRAINEE
lines.text: Ten minutes. He bought ten minutes. I'm going to go and spend them.
lines.spoken: Ten minutes. He bought ten minutes. I'm going to go and spend them.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: The wing is broken. Rusk left his wingmen and ran to the coastal relay works. He's alone there with one relay and his own voice.
lines.spoken: The wing is broken. Rusk left his wingmen and ran to the coastal relay works. He's alone there with one relay and his own voice.

lines.speaker: RUSK
lines.text: Trainee. Land, and I'll tell the city you were misled by a dead man. Fly, and you're the traitor in every history I write.
lines.spoken: Trainee. Land, and I'll tell the city you were misled by a dead man. Fly, and you're the traitor in every history I write.

lines.speaker: TEAL
lines.text: When you have the truth, send it in your own voice. You don't have to sound like me. You never did.
lines.spoken: When you have the truth, send it in your own voice. You don't have to sound like me. You never did.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: I've got every harbour on the net. Every loyalist station is listening for one call sign. Not his. Yours.
lines.spoken: I've got every harbour on the net. Every loyalist station is listening for one call sign. Not his. Yours.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: Break the generators, run the vent and get clear. When his loop stops, he'll come up alone. Then the sky is yours to answer him.
lines.spoken: Break the generators, run the vent and get clear. When his loop stops, he'll come up alone. Then the sky is yours to answer him.

lines.speaker: TRAINEE
lines.text: Marshal. I heard the tape. He didn't sound misled. He sounded like he was counting trucks.
lines.spoken: Marshal. I heard the tape. He didn't sound misled. He sounded like he was counting trucks.

lines.speaker: TRAINEE
lines.text: Sera. Varda trainee, checking in. One of three. The other two are for after.
lines.spoken: Sera. Varda trainee, checking in. One of three. The other two are for after.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: He's down. His relay is dark. Every harbour on the coast is answering. You're on every receiver from the rim to the sea. Say it your way.
lines.spoken: He's down. His relay is dark. Every harbour on the coast is answering. You're on every receiver from the rim to the sea. Say it your way.

lines.speaker: TRAINEE
lines.text: This is Varda trainee, transmitting in the clear. The Air Marshal is down. The emergency is over. It never started.
lines.spoken: This is Varda trainee, transmitting in the clear. The Air Marshal is down. The emergency is over. It never started.

lines.speaker: TRAINEE
lines.text: The orders were forged. The names were dead men's. An orchard was burned for a seed tin. Teal flew the pass so the trucks could get out.
lines.spoken: The orders were forged. The names were dead men's. An orchard was burned for a seed tin. Teal flew the pass so the trucks could get out.

lines.speaker: TRAINEE
lines.text: His name was Teal. He was not a deserter. Amend your records. For Teal. For the rim. We are coming home.
lines.spoken: His name was Teal. He was not a deserter. Amend your records. For Teal. For the rim. We are coming home.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: Varda trainee, Varda Control. Check-in received. Two of three. Come home and make the third in person.
lines.spoken: Varda trainee, Varda Control. Check-in received. Two of three. Come home and make the third in person.

lines.speaker: TEAL
lines.text: ...the sky will still be there.
lines.spoken: ...the sky will still be there.

lines.speaker: LOG
lines.text: VARDA RIM ROSTER. TEAL: KILLED IN ACTION, NOT DESERTED. INSTRUCTOR'S CHAIR: FILLED.
lines.spoken: Varda Rim roster. Teal: killed in action, not deserted. Instructor's chair: filled.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: SERA: High contacts are guiding the patrols. The trucks need that sky clear.
lines.spoken: High contacts are guiding the patrols. The trucks need that sky clear.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: SERA: The road is open. Count the trucks at Varda.
lines.spoken: The road is open. Count the trucks at Varda.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: SERA: Fuel tanks only. The grain silos beside them feed families.
lines.spoken: Fuel tanks only. The grain silos beside them feed families.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: SERA: Vulture flight inbound. Leave the works. Survive; this is no duel.
lines.spoken: Vulture flight inbound. Leave the works. Survive; this is no duel.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: SERA: You are clear. I kept his orders on tape.
lines.spoken: You are clear. I kept his orders on tape.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: SERA: Iron Coast ahead. Cargo ships and fuel barges; leave the market clear.
lines.spoken: Iron Coast ahead. Cargo ships and fuel barges; leave the market clear.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: SERA: Harbour traffic copied. We can follow the orders inland.
lines.spoken: Harbour traffic copied. We can follow the orders inland.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: SERA: Copy before you cut. We need the signature, not just wreckage.
lines.spoken: Copy before you cut. We need the signature, not just wreckage.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: SERA: Guns have the ridge. Take the canyon.
lines.spoken: Guns have the ridge. Take the canyon.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: SERA: I stay in the tower. Keep bombers off the transmitter.
lines.spoken: I stay in the tower. Keep bombers off the transmitter.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: SERA: Thirty-five seconds sent. Two garrisons are answering.
lines.spoken: Thirty-five seconds sent. Two garrisons are answering.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: SERA: Six bombers west. Keep them off the tower until the window closes.
lines.spoken: Six bombers west. Keep them off the tower until the window closes.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: SERA: Transmitter is live. Hold this sky for thirty-five seconds.
lines.spoken: Transmitter is live. Hold this sky for thirty-five seconds.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: SERA: A bomber reached the tower. We have lost the transmitter.
lines.spoken: A bomber reached the tower. We have lost the transmitter.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: SERA: Green beacon is ours. Clear the guns above the beach.
lines.spoken: Green beacon is ours. Clear the guns above the beach.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: SERA: The landing is through. There is smoke over Teklan.
lines.spoken: The landing is through. There is smoke over Teklan.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: SERA: Keep the valley between you and the long-range guns.
lines.spoken: Keep the valley between you and the long-range guns.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: SERA: The corridor is open. Two civilian flights are ready.
lines.spoken: The corridor is open. Two civilian flights are ready.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: SERA: Pads waking up. Strike the aircraft before they climb.
lines.spoken: Pads waking up. Strike the aircraft before they climb.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: SERA: Docks and pen mouths feed this line. Cut their supply route.
lines.spoken: Docks and pen mouths feed this line. Cut their supply route.

lines.speaker: RIM TOWER
lines.text: RIVER TOWER: Cleared to land southbound. Racks ready; damage stays.
lines.spoken: Cleared to land southbound. Racks ready; damage stays.

lines.speaker: RIM TOWER
lines.text: RIVER TOWER: Ammunition aboard. Cleared for takeoff.
lines.spoken: Ammunition aboard. Cleared for takeoff.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: SERA: One airliner cannot climb. Watch both altitude bands.
lines.spoken: One airliner cannot climb. Watch both altitude bands.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: SERA: Both flights are clear. Vulture Two is calling from the array.
lines.spoken: Both flights are clear. Vulture Two is calling from the array.

lines.speaker: TRUCK
lines.text: ORCHARD ONE: Fighters above the cloud. We need cover.
lines.spoken: Fighters above the cloud. We need cover.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: SERA: Another high group. Orchard One, keep your course.
lines.spoken: Another high group. Orchard One, keep your course.

lines.speaker: TRUCK
lines.text: ORCHARD TWO: Cannot climb. Fighters on the saddle!
lines.spoken: Cannot climb. Fighters on the saddle!

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: SERA: More contacts low. Emergency crews await beyond the pass.
lines.spoken: More contacts low. Emergency crews await beyond the pass.

lines.speaker: TRUCK
lines.text: ORCHARD ONE: Last ridge ahead. Three fighters closing high.
lines.spoken: Last ridge ahead. Three fighters closing high.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: SERA: Rime crossing. Optional intercept; the families come first.
lines.spoken: Rime crossing. Optional intercept; the families come first.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: SERA: Orchard Two stays low. Leave room to descend.
lines.spoken: Orchard Two stays low. Leave room to descend.

lines.speaker: TRUCK
lines.text: ORCHARD TWO: They can see the escort. Stay with us to the ridge.
lines.spoken: They can see the escort. Stay with us to the ridge.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: SERA: Eight towers. The command array is his; the crater is your way in.
lines.spoken: Eight towers. The command array is his; the crater is your way in.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: SERA: Ejection marked. Marines are moving.
lines.spoken: Ejection marked. Marines are moving.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: SERA: Jammers in the ravine. Clear the plane a channel.
lines.spoken: Jammers in the ravine. Clear the plane a channel.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: SERA: Fighters beyond the fog. Keep them off the evidence plane.
lines.spoken: Fighters beyond the fog. Keep them off the evidence plane.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: SERA: Missiles low over the ice. The dish must keep talking.
lines.spoken: Missiles low over the ice. The dish must keep talking.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: SERA: Archive received. Order zero-zero-zero-one. Rusk.
lines.spoken: Archive received. Order zero-zero-zero-one. Rusk.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: SERA: Loyalist troops below. Keep Rusk's armour off their streets.
lines.spoken: Loyalist troops below. Keep Rusk's armour off their streets.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: SERA: Bombers incoming. They are turning on the city.
lines.spoken: Bombers incoming. They are turning on the city.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: SERA: Clear the bunkers ahead of the column.
lines.spoken: Clear the bunkers ahead of the column.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: SERA: Both squads answering from the streets. Parliament has a road home.
lines.spoken: Both squads answering from the streets. Parliament has a road home.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: SERA: Rusk leads four wingmen. Vulture Lead is back over the capital.
lines.spoken: Rusk leads four wingmen. Vulture Lead is back over the capital.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: SERA: He left his wing. Rusk is running for the coast.
lines.spoken: He left his wing. Rusk is running for the coast.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: SERA: Generators first. Then the central vent. Leave yourself a way out.
lines.spoken: Generators first. Then the central vent. Leave yourself a way out.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: SERA: You are clear. His loop has stopped. Rusk is coming up alone.
lines.spoken: You are clear. His loop has stopped. Rusk is coming up alone.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: Six bombers, our paint and codes. Stop them before the north coast.
lines.spoken: Six bombers, our paint and codes. Stop them before the north coast.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: SERA: Follow the power line north. Their bombers are parked on the farm.
lines.spoken: Follow the power line north. Their bombers are parked on the farm.

lines.speaker: BROADCAST
lines.text: FARM CONTROL: Bombers, start engines! Get them off the ground!
lines.spoken: Bombers, start engines! Get them off the ground!

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: SERA: Four down. Their guns are still up, watch the base edges.
lines.spoken: Four down. Their guns are still up, watch the base edges.

lines.speaker: BROADCAST
lines.text: FARM CONTROL: The pads are burning. Nobody takes off from here.
lines.spoken: The pads are burning. Nobody takes off from here.

lines.speaker: MARINE
lines.text: LANTERN 2: One bomber left. Finish it, trainee.
lines.spoken: One bomber left. Finish it, trainee.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: SERA: Enemy airspace. Site one is on the ridge north-west of you.
lines.spoken: Enemy airspace. Site one is on the ridge north-west of you.

lines.speaker: MARINE
lines.text: LANTERN 2: Dome down. Good hit, trainee.
lines.spoken: Dome down. Good hit, trainee.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: SERA: Five domes down. Site two is on the saddle west-north-west.
lines.spoken: Five domes down. Site two is on the saddle west-north-west.

lines.speaker: MARINE
lines.text: LANTERN 2: One dome left. Finish it and we go home.
lines.spoken: One dome left. Finish it and we go home.

lines.speaker: RIM TOWER
lines.text: RIM TOWER: Trainee, gear check. Cleared to land, runway three-six.
lines.spoken: Trainee, gear check. Cleared to land, runway three-six.

lines.speaker: RIM TOWER
lines.text: RIM TOWER: Runway in sight. You're on the centreline.
lines.spoken: Runway in sight. You're on the centreline.

lines.speaker: RIM TOWER
lines.text: RIM TOWER: Short final. Glide path is good, hold it there.
lines.spoken: Short final. Glide path is good, hold it there.

lines.speaker: RIM TOWER
lines.text: RIM TOWER: Touchdown. Nice and gentle.
lines.spoken: Touchdown. Nice and gentle.

lines.speaker: RIM TOWER
lines.text: RIM TOWER: Welcome home. Sera wants that film before you unstrap.
lines.spoken: Welcome home. Sera wants that film before you unstrap.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: SERA: High flyers ahead. Break their jammers to get radar back.
lines.spoken: High flyers ahead. Break their jammers to get radar back.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: SERA: One courier down. Two still watching the road.
lines.spoken: One courier down. Two still watching the road.

lines.speaker: MARINE
lines.text: LANTERN 2: One transport left. The trucks are counting on us.
lines.spoken: One transport left. The trucks are counting on us.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: SERA: Rig to the east, refinery to the west. Burn them before dawn.
lines.spoken: Rig to the east, refinery to the west. Burn them before dawn.

lines.speaker: MARINE
lines.text: LANTERN 2: Tanks are going up like flares. Keep it coming.
lines.spoken: Tanks are going up like flares. Keep it coming.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: SERA: Halfway there. The platform's guns are still awake.
lines.spoken: Halfway there. The platform's guns are still awake.

lines.speaker: MARINE
lines.text: LANTERN 3: Nearly there. Don't stop at the number, trainee.
lines.spoken: Nearly there. Don't stop at the number, trainee.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: SERA: That's two thousand. Keep burning it until the clock runs out.
lines.spoken: That's two thousand. Keep burning it until the clock runs out.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: SERA: Iron Coast. Warships and fuel barges only; leave the market clear.
lines.spoken: Iron Coast. Warships and fuel barges only; leave the market clear.

lines.speaker: MARINE
lines.text: LANTERN 2: Ships are slipping their moorings. Catch them in the basin.
lines.spoken: Ships are slipping their moorings. Catch them in the basin.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: SERA: Halfway. The pontoon SAMs are still awake. Mind the warnings.
lines.spoken: Halfway. The pontoon SAMs are still awake. Mind the warnings.

lines.speaker: MARINE
lines.text: LANTERN 3: Nearly there. Don't stop at the number, trainee.
lines.spoken: Nearly there. Don't stop at the number, trainee.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: SERA: Harbour traffic copied. We can follow the orders inland.
lines.spoken: Harbour traffic copied. We can follow the orders inland.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: SERA: Copy before you cut. We need the signature, not just wreckage.
lines.spoken: Copy before you cut. We need the signature, not just wreckage.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: SERA: Lira log copied. Keep moving to the next installation.
lines.spoken: Lira log copied. Keep moving to the next installation.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: SERA: Merel log copied. One transmitter remains.
lines.spoken: Merel log copied. One transmitter remains.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: SERA: I stay in the tower. Keep bombers off the transmitter.
lines.spoken: I stay in the tower. Keep bombers off the transmitter.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: SERA: Transmitter is live. Hold this sky for thirty-five seconds.
lines.spoken: Transmitter is live. Hold this sky for thirty-five seconds.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: SERA: Green beacon is ours. Clear the guns above the beach.
lines.spoken: Green beacon is ours. Clear the guns above the beach.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: SERA: Teal taught us: weather hides a turn. Keep moving.
lines.spoken: Teal taught us: weather hides a turn. Keep moving.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: SERA: The landing is through. There is smoke over Teklan.
lines.spoken: The landing is through. There is smoke over Teklan.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: SERA: Keep the valley between you and the long-range guns.
lines.spoken: Keep the valley between you and the long-range guns.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: SERA: Pads waking up. Strike the aircraft before they climb.
lines.spoken: Pads waking up. Strike the aircraft before they climb.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: SERA: Docks and pen mouths feed this line. Cut their supply route.
lines.spoken: Docks and pen mouths feed this line. Cut their supply route.
